title: Hef Unit Upgrades ATB Patch 1.0.0
author: Kylles
description:
This is my first proper (sub)mod, I triple checked everything but let me know if there's an issue !

This patch brings the power of Dirty_Dan's "Masterworks of Vaul's Anvil - Unit Upgrades for High Elves" to Kerberos' "Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom" and it's associated mods : Dusts Corrupted Heroes, Corrupted Wood Elf Units for Slaanesh, Readman's CCC (and BBB) and Legendary High Elven Characters [LHEC].

Adds a Unit upgrade system similar to the Greenskin scrap upgrades to the High Elf factions. They cost a new resource called Splendour which is gained by having exceptional leaders under your command, constructing court buildings and holding special important landmarks.

- Masterworks of Vaul's Anvil steam page

You can now upgrade all of Alarielle's corrupted units with Good Stuff™ such as bonus damage, melee stats, range and attributes like devastating flanker or regeneration. More powerful upgrades are more expensive and it will take several turns of Splendour income to upgrade your units, only making a minor impact on campaign balance. Keep in mind high elf IAs will use them too !

Most Corrupted Landmarks available throughout Alarielle extended campaign (including Magical Forests and Azazel Realm's Kislev and Cathay) now provide Splendour income or Splendour capacity for Settlements buildings.

Obviously, You will need the following mods (maybe not hard requirements ? untested) :

Masterworks of Vaul's Anvil - Unit Upgrades for High Elves <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2870899314>

Alarielle, Temptations Bloom and it's requirements <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3644437727> or <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/42028-alarielle-temptations-bloom/> on Loverslab

Dusts Corrupted Heroes <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3815990781>

Legendary High Elven Characters <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2897366143>

Corrupted Wood Elf Units for Slaanesh <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3566849815>

Readman Beautiful Bold Buildings <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3497485732>

Readman Coalesced Character Creations <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3501984780>

All of Alarielle, Temptations Bloom recomendation are also recommended ! in particular, some that are not mentionned curently on ATB's loverslab page

Alivia's Lake Tales (Heroes: Ymira, Nymeria and Lyra) <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3832569070>

Citadel of Dusk Standalone (Dust) <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3829276482>

Lord Hero Swap - 9.0 Fix (Unofficial) <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3810275955> Goes very well with LHEC (dont swap Alarielle)

The Lord_Hero_Swap : LHEC patch on steam is not up to date currently, you can use this scuffed update in files Dust_HefLords_Patch_9.pack (updated the one line that crashes)

Join the discord: <https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk> and ping my lazy ass for an update or a fix @Kyllez on discord

Known Issues :

Most modded units wont show their proper art in the upgrade menu (not sure how to fix yet)

Transforming a unit (eg : Sister of Avelorn => Sister of Sensation) will lose the upgrades

Modded lords and Techs are not patched to give Splendour, i don't think it's necessary but let me know
